title: DIP: direct dependencies on details
purpose: Show traditional top-down module/function dependency tree.
alt: Program이 구체 Module과 Function 세부 구현에 직접 의존하는 전통적인 계층 구조
requiredChecks: Program depends on two concrete Modules.
First Module depends on one Function; second on two Functions.
All dependencies point from high-level program/module toward concrete lower-level details.
Caption identifies direct implementation dependency, not data-flow or inheritance.
prompt: Create a NEW ORIGINAL English raster technical diagram for an IT reference blog. Opaque white background, large navy sans-serif typography, readable monospaced identifiers, restrained blue/teal/amber cards, wide gutters, no copied slide composition or logo. Include only the listed operations and labels: do not invent full code bodies, access modifiers, methods or extra relationships. Title 'DIP: direct dependencies on details'. Clean3leveltree. TOP Program. MIDDLE two cards 'Module A' 'Module B'. BOTTOM Function A underModuleA; Function B1andFunctionB2 underModuleB. Dashedarrows Program→eachModule, ModuleA→FunctionA, ModuleB→FunctionB1/B2. Label 'depends on concrete implementation'. Footer 'Higher-level code directly depends on lower-level details'. No reversedarrowsorimplementslabels.
